## P063 — `LocalStagingOutsideTemporaryPath` {#p063}

**Tier:** `warn` · **Scope:** `app` · **Category:** `local-staging` · **Autofixable:** — · **Since:** 0.55.0

> Local staging path built from WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_PATH_TEMPLATE without a TEMPORARY_PATH root

**Rationale:** WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_PATH_TEMPLATE expands to an object-store key
('artifacts/apps/<app>/workflows/<workflow>/<run>'). Used as a local directory it
resolves against the container working directory, which is commonly read-only on a
customer-hosted runtime. The connector passes preflight, because nothing has been
written yet, and then every fetch activity fails with LocalVolumeUnwritableError. The
SDK's writable scratch prefix is TEMPORARY_PATH: root every local path built from the
key there.

### What correct looks like

- **Compliant example:** application_sdk/templates/sql_app.py — `SqlApp.run()` wraps
  `WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_PATH_TEMPLATE.format(...)` in `os.path.join(TEMPORARY_PATH, ...)` and
  hands that rooted path to every extract and transform task;
  `get_object_store_prefix()` strips the root back off, so the object-store key is
  unchanged.
- **Migrate with:** [`programs/areas/prescriptions.prose.md`](https://github.com/atlanhq/application-sdk/blob/main/packages/conformance/conformance/programs/areas/prescriptions.prose.md)

Flags a `WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_PATH_TEMPLATE.format(...)` call whose result is not rooted
under `TEMPORARY_PATH`.  The template is an object-store key; a connector that writes
its extract files under it writes relative to the container working directory, which is
read-only on many customer-hosted runtimes.

The call is rooted, and not flagged, when an enclosing expression also names
`TEMPORARY_PATH` (`os.path.join(TEMPORARY_PATH, ...)`), when it is bound to a local that
a same-function expression joins with `TEMPORARY_PATH`, or when it is returned from a
helper whose every call in the module is rooted.  A value passed straight to
`get_object_store_prefix` / `normalize_key` or to a `storage_path=` keyword is an
object-store key, not a local path, and is not flagged. A literal `artifacts/...` string
is not matched: apps hold object-store keys with that spelling that never touch local
disk.

Fix: `os.path.join(TEMPORARY_PATH, WORKFLOW_OUTPUT_PATH_TEMPLATE.format(...))` (`from
application_sdk.constants import TEMPORARY_PATH`).  Object-store calls keep receiving
the key, because `get_object_store_prefix` and `normalize_key` strip `TEMPORARY_PATH`
back off.

Suppress a value that is only ever an object-store key with a justification: `#
conformance: ignore[P063] <reason>`.
